playstyle.identity: Xayah is a feather-recalling ADC who can become untargetable during her ultimate. She excels when fighting with Rakan and at rooting enemies who step in her feather lines.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: abilities leave feathers. Q throws 2 feathers. W gives attack speed and lets autos pass through (leaves feathers). E recalls all feathers, rooting enemies hit by 3+. R throws feathers and goes untargetable. Set up feathers, E to root, combo with Rakan.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xayah spikes at level 6 with her safety R. Kraken and crit scale her. She's strong with good feather setup and Rakan.

passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.summary: Abilities throw feathers that stay on the ground.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Xayah's next autos throw feathers that pass through targets and drop on the ground behind them.

abilities.name: Double Daggers
abilities.summary: Throw two feathers that deal damage in a line.
abilities.details: Xayah throws two daggers that deal damage to all enemies they pass through, each leaving a feather.

abilities.name: Deadly Plumage
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed; autos pass through and leave feathers.
abilities.details: Xayah creates a storm of blades, gaining attack speed. Her autos deal increased damage, pass through targets, and leave feathers. If Rakan is nearby, he also gains the buff.

abilities.name: Bladecaller
abilities.summary: Recall all feathers; root enemies hit by 3+.
abilities.details: Xayah recalls all feathers, dealing damage to enemies they pass through. Enemies hit by 3 or more feathers are rooted.

abilities.name: Featherstorm
abilities.summary: Become untargetable and throw a fan of feathers.
abilities.details: Xayah leaps into the air, becoming untargetable, then throws a fan of feathers that damage enemies.
